summary_1line: Vyasa instructs disciples on proper transmission of the Vedas; they depart to spread them, and Narada urges Vyasa to resume Vedic recitation with his son.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vyasa’s disciples joyfully embrace each other on the mountain after receiving his permission to spread and subdivide the Vedas.
Narada arrives at the quiet mountain hermitage and questions Vyasa sitting alone in silence where Vedic chants once echoed.
Vyasa and his son Suka sit together in the hermitage loudly reciting the Vedas, their voices imagined as filling the three worlds.
